EAS 775 mJ is rated at ID 150 A (Table 2), and Diagram 13 caps the avalanche current at about 150 A per device from a 25 °C start, less from 100 °C and 150 °C. Paralleled MOSFETs do not share avalanche: the device with the lowest V(BR)DSS conducts first, and the datasheet states no sharing.
